'''Demolitions Squad 419''' was a military unit in the service of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. Around the time of [[Treaty of Coruscant]] the entire squad with in captivity of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] in the [[Troida Military Workshop]] on the planet of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. Because of the treaty, the planned rescue mission was not authorized, so a young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Fortris Gall]] decided to infiltrate the workshop and free the squad single-handed.
